notes.title: Play Together Festival Stream
notes.content:
We're so happy we're finally live! We hope you have fun puzzling and goofing around! 
There is a little announcement we want to share with you all:

Goofs and wholesome puzzling fun await you during Steams "Remote Play Together Festival" from March 25th - 29th. We will be streaming Doig and Swift - a superwholesome animator and entertainer duo - as they delve into the first levels of Couch Monsters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39947564/4061160c3aae72522e8bc89fcd793a44a5ef7a29.png[/img]

We hope to see you around! :D
Cheers,
~ Your Couch Monsters crew
